implementation.persistence: A bounded serial writer owns private checksummed receipts under one process lease. Reservations precede work; completed responses or reconciliation markers precede acknowledgment.
implementation.crash_gap: Interrupted reservations become reconciliation markers. They are never automatically reexecuted.
implementation.erasure: A durable tenant barrier precedes forget, forgetting maintenance, consolidation, document deletion, and restore publication; it invalidates late completions and scrubs existing response bodies while retaining protected keys.
implementation.restart: Startup recovers pending scrubbing and retired receipts before admission. A fresh monotonic retention window uses at least the longest configured or recorded TTL.
implementation.expiry: Expired receipts are durably renamed into cleanup staging before overwrite and unlink so interruption cannot leave a damaged live control header.

regression_coverage: Exact response and committed-error replay across restart
Actual child process termination before reservation publication, after durable reservation, after business mutation, and after receipt completion
Abrupt HTTP server restart after acknowledgment
Erasure admission barrier, other-tenant isolation, preserved current erasure response, and invalidated late completion
Process interruption after erasure-barrier publication, during body overwrite, and after receipt retirement
Scrub write/sync faults preserve the barrier until successful startup cleanup
Corrupt header/body checksum, oversized header length, truncation and trailing bytes fail startup
Capacity and body-budget boundaries, monotonic expiry boundary, conservative TTL after restart, and exclusive ownership
HTTP forgetting and document deletion scrub retained read responses and protect their keys after restart
Existing restore, authentication, admission, and operational integration suites
limitations: Receipt and business operations are separate commits; this is bounded retry protection, not arbitrary exactly-once execution.
Receipts may contain plaintext source text; encrypted-volume deployment remains required for encryption at rest.
Restart extends retention; reducing configured bounds below retained data fails startup.
Fault tests cover process termination and injected I/O failure, not physical power loss or filesystem snapshots.
Validation was local macOS arm64; no Windows runtime or performance benchmark was run.
